h1: Custom Edwards Shorts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Edwards shorts in bulk for your team or event. Reliable quality and fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Edwards shorts offer a reliable choice for bulk orders, known for consistent sizing and durable fabrics that hold up to frequent wear. Whether you need moisture-wicking performance shorts for a corporate wellness program or classic cotton gym shorts for a company picnic, Edwards provides options that decorate cleanly with screen printing or embroidery. Choose from men's, women's, and youth styles to outfit your entire group with a unified look.
heroAltText: Custom Edwards shorts in bulk for corporate teams and events, featuring moisture-wicking and cotton styles
